name: Grip, Hold, Pin - Curator Walkthrough
description: Join Aayati Sengupta, Curator of Grip, Hold, Pin, for a walkthrough of the exhibition. Through a close reading of the works on view, the walkthrough will explore wrestling as more than a sport—as a site where discipline, kinship, identity and everyday life converge. Drawing on photography, archival material and moving image, Grip, Hold, Pin traces the histories and lived experiences that shape wrestling cultures across India, inviting audiences to consider the relationships between body, labour, tradition and representation.

name: Wrestler in the Making
description:
This online conversation features Shri Kiran Bavadekar, a wrestler and bodybuilder from Kolhapur who pursued sport despite having contracted polio as a child. Drawing on his journey to national-level competition and his work training young athletes, the conversation explores disability, access to sport, and the role of resilience and community in shaping sporting practice.

This is in conjunction with programming for Grip,Hold,Pin.

name: Photo Walk: Traditional Kushti
'A Moving Line’: Evolving Identities in Comics and Graphic Narratives
description: Join us for the book discussion of A Moving Line, a celebration of India’s rich history of visual storytelling. Comic creator and visual artists Rahil Mohsin and Mia Jose will be in conversation with designer Kriti Monga to reflect on how storytelling in graphic narratives has evolved over centuries and the many nuances and developments in it.
